games.title: Jazz Jackrabbit

setup.hint: First start: setting up the sound card (Sound Blaster 16, High Quality)…

controls.keys: Arrow keys move · Alt jumps · Space shoots · Ctrl changes weapon · Esc opens the menu

games.install: Choose a zip of your Jazz Jackrabbit folder (or the folder itself) — the one with JAZZ.EXE in it. Any version works: the shareware episode, the CD version or the Holiday specials.

shareware.title: Jazz Jackrabbit shareware episode, version 1.0 (1994)
shareware.notice: Jazz Jackrabbit is shareware by Epic MegaGames, Inc., who own it. Shareware is try-before-you-buy software: Epic let anyone share the first episode for free, unaltered, so you could try it before buying the full game. LövOS includes that original release unchanged.

games.description: Epic MegaGames' 1994 platformer: a green hare with a blaster saves Carrotus from Devan Shell.
